svg.title: runciter: a control plane for agentic work
svg.desc: A board with seven columns: Capture, Analysis, Approved, Build, Review, Merge, and Done. Capture, Approved, and Review are holds where you act; Analysis runs a researcher agent behind a human gate; Build runs a builder agent in an isolated git worktree and verifies with pnpm check; Review is where you read the diff and merge or send it back. A task card, Add a word counter, travels from Capture to Done. Under the board, an event log records that every write appends an event. On the line, runciter carries a task through plumbbob's and checkride's hops as supervised stages.
